The self-report alone is insufficient to verify that the acceptance criteria have been met. While the agent claims all 47 tests pass and describes a plausible root cause and fix, there is no independent evidence (CI logs, test output, code diff, or other artifacts) to corroborate these claims. The acceptance criteria explicitly require that "all 47 tests pass," which demands objective verification, not self-attestation.
